name: flin-linkedin-posts-mcp
description: Read your LinkedIn posts and personal analytics with separate app logins. Automatically updates from stable PyPI releases at startup.

client_id.title: Portability app: Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of your LinkedIn Developer app with Member Data Portability access.

client_secret.title: Portability app: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Required for regular OAuth. Leave empty only if LinkedIn enabled Native PKCE for your app.

redirect_uri.title: Portability app: OAuth callback URL
redirect_uri.description: Register this exact URL in your LinkedIn Developer app's Auth tab.

scopes.title: Portability app: permissions
scopes.description: Permissions approved for the first (portability) app. Configure the second app separately under Analytics permissions.

analytics_client_id.title: Analytics app: Client ID
analytics_client_id.description: Optional second app approved for Community Management. Leave all analytics fields empty until ready.

analytics_client_secret.title: Analytics app: Client Secret
analytics_client_secret.description: Client secret of the second app. Leave empty only if native PKCE is enabled for that app.

analytics_redirect_uri.title: Analytics app: OAuth callback URL
analytics_redirect_uri.description: Register this exact URL in the second app, for example http://127.0.0.1:63142/callback.

analytics_scopes.title: Analytics app: permissions
analytics_scopes.description: Leave empty for r_member_postAnalytics. For follower statistics enter r_member_postAnalytics r_member_profileAnalytics. Use only approved scopes and log into analytics again after changing them.
